description_en: Queries the protection templates of a protected object or a protected object group
description_zh: 查询防护对象或防护组的防护模板
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-resource-templates --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-9lb3600000e --resource mitsuichemicals.cn-waf --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDefenseResourceTemplates

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the protected object or protected object group, or the ID of the protected asset to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的防护对象、防护组名称或防护资产ID
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en: The type of the protected resource
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the protection rule. Valid values:
defense (default): protection rule.
whitelist: whitelist rule
parameters.help_zh:
防护规则类型。取值：
defense（默认）：防护规则
whitelist：白名单规则
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the protection rule
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the protection rule
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the protection template to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的防护模板名称
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

DefenseScene.description_en: The protection scenario. For more information, refer to the DefenseScene parameter in [CreateDefenseRule]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html）
DefenseScene.description_zh: 防护场景。更多信息，请参见[CreateDefenseRule]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html）的**DefenseScene**参数

DefenseSubScene.description_en:
The sub-scenario of the protection template. Valid values:
web: the bot management web protection scenario template.
app: the bot management app protection scenario template.
basic: the bot management basic protection template
DefenseSubScene.description_zh:
防护模版子场景，取值：
web：表示BOT管理网页防护场景模版。
app：表示BOT管理APP防护场景模版。
basic：表示BOT管理基础防护模版

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the protection template was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
GmtModified.description_zh: 防护模板创建时间，格式为时间戳，单位：毫秒

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the protection template

TemplateName.description_en: The name of the protection template

TemplateOrigin.description_en: The source of the protection template. The value custom indicates that the template is user-defined
TemplateOrigin.description_zh: 要创建的防护模板来源。取值为custom，表示用户自定义

TemplateStatus.description_en:
The status of the protection template. Valid values:
0: disabled.
1: enabled
TemplateStatus.description_zh:
防护模板状态。取值：
0：表示关闭。
1：表示开启

TemplateType.description_en:
The templatetype of the protection template. Valid values:
user_default: user default protection.
user_custom: user custom protection
TemplateType.description_zh:
防护模板类型。取值：
user_default：表示用户默认防护。
user_custom：表示用户自定义防护
